sources.title: Qwen3.8-27B-TURBO-Fable-Cold-Fusion-735-882-Heretic-Uncensored-NEO ...
sources.snippet: A TURBO multi-stage fine-tune of Qwen3.8‑27B that shortens internal "thinking" token blocks and raises ARC benchmarks (8‑bit ARC‑C ≈735, ARC‑E ≈882). It ships GGUF quants (regular and MTP, Neo‑Imatrix), vision support and 256k context for local multimodal inference on consumer GPUs.

sources.title: Qwen3.8 27B TURBO Fable Cold Fusion 735 882 Heretic Uncensored NM DAU
sources.snippet: Qwen3.8 27B TURBO Fable Cold Fusion 735 882 Heretic Uncensored NM DAU is a 27.8B-parameter open language model from DavidAU in the Qwen 3.8 family. It supports a context window of up to 262,144 tokens. At BF16 it needs about 56.31 GB of VRAM — see which GPUs and Macs can run it below. More
